# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Games

## 1. Number Placement Puzzles
*(Primary mechanic: filling cells with numbers according to constraints)*
- Fillomino
- Hitori
- Juosan
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Ripple Effect
- Sudoku

## 2. Loop Drawing Puzzles
*(Primary mechanic: drawing a single continuous closed loop)*
- Dotchi-Loop
- Masyu
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Nagareru
- Slitherlink
- Suraromu
- Yajilin

## 3. Cell Shading Puzzles
*(Primary mechanic: painting or coloring cells black according to constraints)*
- Choco Banana
- Heyawake
- Kurodoko
- Kurotto
- Nurikabe
- Nuritwin
- Tilepaint
- Usowan

## 4. Region Division Puzzles
*(Primary mechanic: partitioning the grid into defined regions or blocks)*
- Chained Block
- Double Choco
- Five Cells
- LITS
- Norinori
- Sashigane
- Shikaku
- Sto-stone

## 5. Path and Connection Puzzles
*(Primary mechanic: connecting elements or tracing paths between points)*
- Hashiwokakero
- Hebi
- Numberlink
- Pencils
- Satogaeri
- Yosenabe

## 6. Object Placement Puzzles
*(Primary mechanic: placing discrete objects into the grid according to rules)*
- Akari
- Evolomino
- Shakashaka

## 7. Hybrid Shading and Structure Puzzles
*(Primary mechanic: combining region identification with shading or marking constraints)*
- Nurimeizu
- Nurimisaki
- Sto-stone *(moved — see below)*
- Juosan *(moved — see below)*
- Makaro *(moved — see below)*
